description: Control character in a KEY: sort order is by UTF-16 code units of the UNESCAPED key string, not by the bytes of the escaped serialization. The two keys are U+001F INFORMATION SEPARATOR ONE (code unit 0x001F) and U+0020 SPACE (code unit 0x0020). Code-unit order: 0x001F < 0x0020, so the U+001F key sorts first and the canonical form begins {"\u001f":...}. A wrong implementation that sorts by the escaped bytes sees 0x20 (space) before 0x5C (backslash that opens \u001f), puts space first, and produces a different pre-image and digest. See jcs-n-control-key-escaped-sort-contrast (vector 29) for the both-directions check.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-01 §3.1 step 2 (RFC 8785 §3.2.3 key ordering by UTF-16 code units; §3.2.2.2 key escaping)
